verified.result: [plan-check] plan.md: 3 call paths, 9 lines. Every cited file and line checks out.

decisions.decision: Read plugin skills from installed_plugins.json v2 only, user scope or this project's projectPath
decisions.why: It is the registry Claude Code reads; a version check skips an unknown format instead of misreading it
decisions.rejected: Walking the plugin cache, which keeps uninstalled and old versions

decisions.decision: Only an explicit enabledPlugins false marks a plugin off
decisions.why: Installed plugins are often absent from every settings file yet run
decisions.rejected: Requiring true, which flags working hooks

decisions.decision: Skill check lives in build-pipeline.py; graph calls it per hook
decisions.why: Build and graph give the same sentence from one function

decisions.decision: BuildReport.warnings parsed from [build] lines before the summary
decisions.rejected: A new warning prefix that could break readers

plan.summary: Skill catalog + per-hook problem in build-pipeline.py, surfaced by the graph and the build
plan.key_finding: plan_build has no project root, so the skill check runs after it over the resolved hooks

approach: build-pipeline.py gains skill_catalog and skill_problem; the build warns per bad skill hook and the graph carries choices.skillCatalog and hook.problem. The protocol adds those fields and BuildReport.warnings, lifted from the build log.
